content: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid vacation per calendar year. New employees accrue vacation from their first day of work.
Vacation requests are submitted in the HR portal at least two weeks before the first day off.
Up to 5 unused vacation days carry over into the next calendar year. Any remaining unused days expire on December 31.
Sick leave needs a doctor's note after three consecutive days of absence.
Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with their manager's approval.
Travel expenses are reimbursed within 30 days when receipts are uploaded to the finance portal.
Acme full-time employees receive 30 days of paid vacation per year, and new employees get 5 bonus vacation days that never expire.
Acme salaries are paid on the 25th of each month.
